inputs.prompt: Photograph of a long scrubbed pale-oak trestle table against a lime-washed wall, in a working pottery studio, a few minutes after a meal: a torn heel of bread and a folded linen napkin pushed aside. Empty space lower-left for a plate to be composited later; leave that area as bare scrubbed oak with knife marks. Light: one soft north window from frame-left, late afternoon, no fill, open grey shadows, highlights not clipped. Camera: 4:5 vertical, about 55mm equivalent, seated eye level, 35 degrees down, natural perspective. Colour: pale oak and off-white ground, no saturated props, no ochre accents. Avoid: marble or stone counters, steam, herb sprigs, untouched place settings, black backgrounds, spotlights, gold or metallic rims, any ceramic plate in the empty area, any text or logo.
